entities.name: Boc-protected substrate
observations: Contains a tert-butoxycarbonyl-protected terminal 3-aminopropyl group attached to a methylated fused N-heteroaromatic scaffold.

entities.name: TFA in dichloromethane
observations: Trifluoroacetic acid in dichloromethane is used for acid-mediated Boc deprotection; dichloromethane serves as solvent.

entities.name: Deprotected diamine product
observations: The product is formed by removal of the Boc carbamate, revealing a terminal primary amine; the fused heteroaromatic scaffold is unchanged.

entities.name: Boc deprotection
observations: Acidic cleavage of the tert-butoxycarbonyl group converts the protected terminal carbamate into a primary amine without coupling, oxidation, or reduction.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetate salt
observations: Because TFA is the deprotection reagent, the isolated amine may be present as its trifluoroacetate salt; the database product is represented as the neutral free base.
